title: From Question to Exploration: Test-Time Adaptation in Semantic Segmentation? (TTAP)
mechanism: A study of classic TTA in segmentation: BN updating brings slight gains or harm, teacher-student is stable but brings no gain on complex shifts, and long-tail imbalance breaks seg TTA even with accurate pseudo-labels. Proposes visual prompt TTA.
adaptation: Failure-mode evidence for rare classes. Use it to justify the benchmark rule that TTA is reported separately and the class-balanced selection in the self-training TTA arms.
min_experiment: Not an experiment. Cite it in the benchmark protocol; its findings are checked by the Tent/SAR/CoTTA rows.
evidence: R (abstract): BN updating slight gain or harm; teacher-student no gain over source on complex shifts; severe long-tail class imbalance problem in seg TTA.
